title: Silver Thief
personality:
The thief who reached the Wyrmheart in Malgrave's vault. Touching it woke the Wyrm and set off the Hollowing.
Everyone has a reason to hate her, and she knows it. She's still after the treasure.
fantasy: The duelist. Sticks to one mark from range, cartwheels past them, never lets go.
silhouette: the long braid, the moth wings and the twin pistols

card.loop: Ranged duelist: stay on one foe, cartwheel, and land the big shot.
card.dash: Cartwheel a short way (from a jump too, carried on to the landing). Your next shot is empowered, a gold glint in your throwing hand: a big shot that, if it lands, gives you the Vault back at once.
card.passive: Each hit on the same foe adds a Mark: +{resource.per_mark%}% damage, with no cap. Knocks heal you.
card.x: A ring opens round you: for {x.time}s blades fly at every foe in it, harder and blighting from its edge.
card.rmb: A short wind-up, then a Bola down the lane: it grounds and slows the first foe and flies on. Catch a second and both are stunned.
card.e: Throw a dagger to your cursor or into a foe. Press E again to blink to it.

weapons.arc_bolts: Bolts from alternating hands every {weapon.primary.rate}s. Each one lands at your cursor.

passive.name: Marks
passive.desc: Every shot that hits puts a Mark on the target (no cap, each lasting {resource.dur}s and refreshed by the next): your shots on them deal +{resource.per_mark%}% per Mark. The empowered shot adds {dash.prime_marks}, the Bola one. A knock heals you {resource.heal_knock%}% of your health on top of the usual knock heal ({resource.heal_assist%}% in all) and bursts a crimson star on them; an assist heals {resource.heal_assist%}%.

dash.name: Vault
dash.desc: A sideways cartwheel of {dash.dist}m the way you move in about half a second (the same from a jump, its speed carried on to the landing; shots pass through it; you can shoot mid-flip) and +{dash.haste%}% speed for {dash.haste_t}s. Your next shot within {dash.primed_t}s is empowered (a gold glint in your throwing hand, flaring as you land): it flies {dash.emp_range-1%}% further and deals +{dash.prime_bonus%}% damage and puts {dash.prime_marks} Marks on them (Marks add to it as to any shot); firing it ends the speed. Landing it gives the Vault back at once. Rank 2: that bonus is {dash.prime_rank%}% bigger; rank 3: twice that.

variants.tap: A {rmb.bola.cast}s wind-up with the lane showing (you keep aiming), then the Bola flies {rmb.bola.range}m: {rmb.bola.dmg} damage and a Mark; the first foe it wraps is Grounded for {rmb.bola.ground}s (no dash, jump or glide) and slowed {rmb.bola.slow%}%, and the Bola flies on {rmb.bola.after}m (a crate it breaks counts as that first catch). It bounces once off a wall. If it catches a second foe, both are stunned {rmb.bola.pair_stun} and take +{rmb.bola.pair_dmg} (TANGLED).
variants.air: Thrown from the air the same way.

e.name: Shadow Knife
e.desc: Throw a dagger to your cursor ({e.range}m at most): it sticks in the first foe on the way ({e.dmg} damage, slowed {e.slow%}% for {e.slow_t}s) or lands where you aimed. Press E again to blink to it at once, leaving a trail of afterimages; after {e.time}s you step to it anyway.

x.name: Encore
x.desc: A violet ring grows round you ({x.grow}s) to {x.reach}m and rides with you; she dances, and for {x.time}s a blade flies from her hands on each beat at each foe inside it ({x.shots} at most): {x.dmg} each, +{x.rim_dmg} in the outer band (the last quarter of its reach), which also blights them for {x.rim_blight}s (healing barely takes). You keep moving, shooting and dashing; casting it gives the Vault back, and every blade refreshes your Marks. Allies are untouched.

rank3.sec: flies {rmb.bola.after_r3}m further after the first foe, the cooldown {cd3.sec}s, and two foes caught pool their Marks
rank3.dash: the empowered bonus twice the rank 2 gain in all, and the Vault's speed boost is half again as big
rank3.kin: sticking refunds {e.refund_wall%}% of the cooldown ({e.refund_foe%}% in a foe), and a knife that sticks in a foe gives the Vault back

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown {rmb.cooldown}s -> {cd3.sec}s, damage +{dmg3.sec%}%; flies {rmb.bola.after_r3}m further after the first foe, and two foes caught pool their Marks.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown {cd3.kin}s; sticking refunds {e.refund_wall%}% of the cooldown ({e.refund_foe%}% in a foe), and a knife that sticks in a foe gives the Vault back.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: the empowered bonus twice the rank 2 gain in all, and the speed boost is half again as big.

tells.half: gold Mark diamonds over the target, one per stack
tells.full: a full ring of eight diamonds spinning fast (more Marks still count); a gold glint in the hand and a gold aim line while the next shot is empowered; a violet ring round her and blades circling her while Encore runs
tells.dash_spent: a white cartwheel arc, dash pip dark; a landed empowered shot flashes the pip back with RESET at her hand
